title: Retire the krn/gate-local required check (D30 amendment)
body:
Outcome: krn/gate-local is no longer a required check; the D30 amendment is recorded; deliver, docs and the krn-lead skill stop requiring the local gate.
Blocked on the operator decision (D30 amendment) with evidence from t-mzsecc0: after PR #164 a green krn/gate proves every isolation file selected by gate:local (28 at d454a95) ran with tests and zero skips, because the strict full run rejects its evidence otherwise.
Scope: ruleset edit (separate grant), krn deliver gate step, KRN-07 text, docs/program, krn-lead skill step 8; supersedes t-eq27hsa if accepted.
